scene_description: Four children are sitting around a campfire in a forest. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks over a fire pit. A green tent is visible in the background, and the children are seated in camping chairs.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round pit in the center of the picture.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people sitting near the fire.

questions.question: Where are the children sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall trees behind the children.
